info.title: cab API
info.description: The JSON API of cab, debate clubs and their sessions. Every page action has an API twin with the same access rules. Signed-in calls use the cab session cookie: sign in on cab in the same browser. Public calls need nothing. Errors are JSON with an `error` text (and `details` per field on validation failures). Rate limits: 60 requests a minute per signed-in account (bursts of up to 20) and 20 a minute per anonymous IP; over the limit the answer is 429 with Retry-After, and every answer carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset.

The public profile and the club's finished sessions with their winners.

get.description: The fields guests answer after their name when they register for any session of the club on the shared registration URL (the /r page; it has no API twin), in form order. Every club's form starts with the locked built-in e-mail field (id "email", label "Your e-mail", required by default), the address the guest's personal link is sent to; the guest's name is asked before the form and is not part of it. Signed-in members are never asked. Club head and cab admins only.

put.description: Replaces the whole definition, the twin of the head's Registration form page. Fields keep the id they are sent with; fields without one get a new id. The locked built-in e-mail field must come first with its id "email": only its required flag and hint are taken from the request, its label and type stay. Guests' earlier answers keep their own copy of each field's label and type, so editing or removing fields never changes them. On 422, details hold stable error codes: details.form is one of locked_removed, locked_moved, too_many_fields, duplicate_id, not_a_list; details.fields maps the field's index to {param: code} with codes required, too_long, invalid_type, options_count, option_too_long, duplicate_options.

get.description: The guests' answers to the club's registration form, one entry per guest with a personal link for the session, oldest first: the rows of the session's Responses page. Answers go by the label they were given under (answers keep a copy), so they stay readable after the form changed: columns are the form's labels in form order, then labels only older answers carry. For the club head only.

answers.description: Label => value (a string, a list of strings for multiple choice, true or false for yes/no); an unanswered field is left out

The participant id; for the head, and for your own registration

answers.description: The guest's answers to the club's registration form, in form order; optional fields left empty are left out. Club head only

id.description: Stable across edits; answers refer to it

type.description: text = short text, longtext = long text, yesno = one checkbox, choice = single choice, multi = multiple choice

options.description: 2 to 20 for choice and multi, empty otherwise

locked.description: A built-in field (the e-mail): it cannot be removed or moved, and only required and hint can change

id.description: Kept when given; a new field leaves it out. The built-in e-mail is "email"

type.description: text = short text, longtext = long text, yesno = one checkbox, choice = single choice, multi = multiple choice

options.description: 2 to 20 different options for choice and multi (a list, or one per line); ignored for other types

FormFieldInput.description: A field as sent; for the locked e-mail only id, required and hint are read

Answer.description: A guest's answer to one registration form field; label and type are copied at answer time, so later form edits never change it

value.description: A string for the text-like types, number and choice (telegram without the @), a list of strings for multi, true or false for yesno

Forbidden.description: Signed in, but not allowed here

NotFound.description: No such club, session, room or request

Conflict.description: Not in this stage of the session

Unprocessable.description: Invalid input or a rule refused it

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests: the caller's bucket is empty. Wait Retry-After seconds.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request is allowed.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests per minute for this caller.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the bucket is full again.
